item.description:
### Added - **DLP dictionaries for what Zscaler has none for:** ICD-10 diagnosis codes, Medicare Beneficiary Identifiers, medical record numbers, card track data, CUI markings, criminal justice records, student records and material non-public information, each citing its source. The wizard creates the ones a framework needs and a DLP rule on each: HIPAA, HITRUST and ZTH Ebook get PHI identifiers and ICD-10 codes; PCI, card track data; NIST and CMMC, CUI markings; CJIS, criminal justice records; FERPA and CIPA, student records; SOX, non-public financial information. Like every DLP rule, they monitor until you set them to Block. Permissive doesn't get them. - **Endpoint DLP** (needs its licence): a Customize switch, off by default, for rules that log sensitive files copied to USB drives, uploaded to personal cloud storage or printed. They only monitor. A tenant without the licence gets a dry-run warning and the rest of the run goes on. - **Cloud Sandbox licence** on Customize: Advanced (the tier's rules, as before) or Standard (one rule that scans Windows executables and libraries).
### Changed - **DLP engines** are built from groups of dictionaries ("any of these and any of those"). The existing rules match exactly as before. - Undo removes the new dictionaries after the engines and rules that use them.
